retirement_reason: These files target superseded pre-registry schema shapes and are retained only as append-only historical design fixtures. They are excluded from current expected-valid/invalid counts.
limitations: Subschema unit cases do not establish complete-object validity.
Cross-object candidate equality, ordering, signature, time, replay, hash, and state-machine behavior are outside JSON Schema and require separately authorized conformance work.
Local validator success is not adoption, publication, authority, cryptographic verification, implementation, or operational evidence.
